entries.heading: None of the funds available to the Department of Defense
ancestors: DIVISION C—-DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2014
entries.text:
Sec. 8050.  None of the funds available to the Department of Defense 
under this Act shall be obligated or expended to pay a contractor under 
a contract with the Department of Defense for costs of any amount paid 
by the contractor to an employee when--
            (1) such costs are for a bonus or otherwise in excess of the 
        normal salary paid by the contractor to the employee; and
            (2) such bonus is part of restructuring costs associated 
        with a business combination.

                      (including transfer of funds)
